signatures.description: Build an in-memory MVCC store in Go that offers snapshot isolation reads plus serializability via rw-dependency cycle detection on commit. Each transaction records reads with their observed versions and write intents; on commit, add rw-antidependency edges from any transaction that overwrote a version you read after your snapshot, detect cycles in the committed-plus-in-flight graph, and abort ONLY transactions that participate in a cycle so write-skew pairs (both reading a sum and inserting a row that changes it) fail while benign concurrent pairs commit. The harness runs concurrent workloads with deterministic scheduling, then asserts the invariant that any serial execution order cannot reproduce the observed results and that aborted transaction counts match the expected conflict graph.
